name: IndexedStack
desc: A subclass of the Stack component that can stack multiple components and specify the index of the component to be displayed, while the rest are hidden.

fields.name: alignment
fields.desc: How to align the non-positioned and partially-positioned children in the stack.

fields.name: textDirection
fields.desc: The text direction with which to resolve [alignment].

fields.name: sizing
fields.desc: How to size the non-positioned children in the stack.

fields.name: index
fields.desc: The index of the child to show.

fields.name: children
fields.desc: The child widgets of the stack.
